description: Create a booking (or a quote with is_quote:true — defaults to a confirmed booking). start_time/end_time accept HH:MM (24h) or plain forms like '6pm'/'6:00 PM'. participants/volunteers set the headcount (default from the package if omitted). comments PRINT on the contract (client-facing detail); manager_notes are internal and do NOT print (put provenance like 'from handwritten note' here). Several dates on one booking: pass dates=[{date, start_time, end_time, project_type_id, price, act_id}, ...] (the first is the main date; price defaults to the SUM of the dates' prices). act_id per date only applies when the account has 'Book multiple acts per booking' on (setting multi_act_booking, Agent plan); otherwise every date gets the booking's act_id.

client_id.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).

price.description: An amount in US dollars, e.g. 250 or 250.00.
